n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

maxn = 510
factorials = [0] * maxn
inv_factorials = [0] * maxn
inverses = [0] * maxn

def precompute():
    factorials[0] = 1
    factorials[1] = 1
    inv_factorials[0] = 1
    inv_factorials[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, maxn):
        factorials[i] = (factorials[i-1] * i) % mod
        inverses[i] = mod - ( (mod // i) * inverses[mod % i] ) % mod
        inv_factorials[i] = (inv_factorials[i-1] * inverses[i]) % mod

def choose(a, b):
    return (factorials[a] * (inv_factorials[b] * inv_factorials[a - b] % mod)) % mod

def sum_of_pairs(x):
    return x * (x + 1) // 2

precompute()

fct = [0] * maxn
cst = [0] * maxn
dp1_alt = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
dp2_alt = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]

fct[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(i):
        val = (choose(i - 1, j) * fct[j]) % mod
        val = (val * fct[i - 1 - j]) % mod
        fct[i] = (fct[i] + val) % mod

        cst[i] = (cst[i] + ( (i + 1) * choose(i - 1, j) % mod) * ((fct[j] * cst[i - 1 - j]) % mod + (fct[i - 1 - j] * cst[j]) % mod) % mod) % mod

        cst[i] = (cst[i] + (choose(i - 1, j) * (sum_of_pairs(j) + sum_of_pairs(i - 1 - j)) % mod) * (fct[j] * fct[i - 1 - j] % mod)) % mod

    fct[i] = (fct[i] * (i + 1)) % mod

dp1_alt[0][0] = 1
for k in range(1, n + 1):
    dp1_alt[k][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, min(m, k) + 1):
        dp1_alt[k][i] = dp1_alt[k - 1][i]
        dp2_alt[k][i] = dp2_alt[k - 1][i]
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            val1 = (fct[j] * dp1_alt[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            val1 = (val1 * choose(i, j)) % mod
            dp1_alt[k][i] = (dp1_alt[k][i] + val1) % mod

            val2 = (cst[j] * dp1_alt[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            val2 = (val2 * choose(i, j)) % mod
            dp2_alt[k][i] = (dp2_alt[k][i] + val2) % mod

            val3 = (fct[j] * dp2_alt[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            val3 = (val3 * choose(i, j)) % mod
            dp2_alt[k][i] = (dp2_alt[k][i] + val3) % mod

print(dp2_alt[n][m])
